mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as corporate profit margins contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates an economic contraction phase, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced corporate output and investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 3.0% signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through elevated corporate earnings and investor confidence in growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where quarterly GDP growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 260.0) signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as discount rates rise and risk appetite declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS < 0.0% change) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) over the prior 3 months indicates a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand regimes (HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 550000.0) support positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through elevated retail sales and housing activity, boosting corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 550000.0.
